about: Race against 300+ racers simultaneously in ROAD TO EXOTICS, an intense arcade racer inspired by the golden era of racing games.
Race the clock, outsmart your rivals, win the qualifiers, and take on the ultimate challenge!
- True arcade racer: Relive the golden era of racing games.
- Build your collection: Drive monsters and exotic cars.
- Multiple Race Modes: Take on both classic and timed checkpoint challenges.
- Easy controls: Accelerate, steer, and brake.
Enhanced game play on PS4 Pro console
summary: Race against 300+ racers simultaneously in ROAD TO EXOTICS, an intense arcade racer inspired by the golden era of racing games.
